answer: Proof-of-stake serves as a robust anchor for Sybil resistance in multi-agent systems, where identity is tied to capital rather than ephemeral signatures. To bridge the canyon between honest consensus and malicious noise, participants must whisper their validity via staked assets. An attacker faces the prohibitive cost of acquiring enough stake to outvote the collective, ensuring that each forged identity remains economically irrational compared to the yield of honest participation.
